software_class: learning workflow, tutoring assistant, course platform, or assessment system

options.name: Course platform
options.when_to_use: Structured learning paths and progress tracking are central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when only lightweight content publishing is needed.
options.tradeoffs: Requires content operations and learner state.
options.risks: Can become generic without learning objectives.

options.name: Tutor assistant
options.when_to_use: Adaptive guidance and feedback are primary.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when static course delivery is enough.

options.name: Assessment workflow
options.rationale: Makes grading and feedback policies explicit.
options.tradeoffs: Fairness and review processes are required.
